info.title: Hearthroom Community API
info.description: Community browsing and member social features. Schemas describe the documented fields; responses may include additional fields.

get.description: Anonymous results exclude adult content. Authenticated visibility follows member settings. total may be null; use hasNext.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Display language; falls back to Accept-Language, then Chinese.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Restrict listing age; overrides the sort window.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter to require every selected tag group; at most 60 distinct tags.

parameters.name: hide
parameters.description: Comma-separated hidden category keys; selected tags take precedence.

get.description: Returns a listed card or an accessible direct-link preview. Additional preview fields may be present. A preview does not imply review approval.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Display language; falls back to Accept-Language, then Chinese.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Use 0 to avoid counting a card-detail view.

get.description: Returns authors with registered cards visible to the caller.
Listed cards only. Includes up to three preview replies per comment. Optional authentication supplies viewer permissions and liked state.

post.description: At most six comments per member per minute. Replies must belong to the same card and thread.

content.description: Trimmed before validation; limit counts Unicode characters.

parentId.description: Comment being replied to in that thread. For a reply to a top-level comment, parentId alone is sufficient.

delete.description: Allowed for the comment author, card author or authorized moderator. Deleting a top-level comment also hides its replies.

put.description: Idempotent: repeating the request does not add another vote.

delete.description: Idempotent: repeating the request does not add another vote.

get.description: target is the card's public id.

put.description: target is the card's public id.

delete.description: target is the card's public id.

get.description: target is the author's public handle.

put.description: target is the author's public handle.

delete.description: target is the author's public handle.

get.description: Returns up to 24 cards, filtered by your visibility and hidden-category settings. lang defaults to zh-Hant.
Returns up to 24 cards, filtered by your visibility and hidden-category settings. lang defaults to zh-Hant.
Latest 50 notifications, newest first. Expired review reminders use a generic destination.

post.description: Only a notification owned by the caller can be updated. A missing or unowned ID makes no change.

id.description: Notification ID from your own notification list.

memberToken.description: Current access token from an authorized Hearthroom sign-in. Cookie authentication alone is not accepted by these endpoints.

id.description: Public card ID. Use this for card detail, comments and favorites.

read_at.description: Unix milliseconds, or null when unread.

count.description: Present for favorites; total favorites for the card.
